import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int from, to;
        int cap, flow;
        Edge(int from, int to, int cap, int flow) {
            this.from = from;
            this.to = to;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.flow = flow;
        }
    }

    static class PushRelabel {
        int N;
        List<Edge> edges;
        List<List<Integer>> G;
        int[] h, inQ, count;
        long[] excess;
        Queue<Integer> Q;

        PushRelabel(int N) {
            this.N = N;
            edges = new ArrayList<>();
            G = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) G.add(new ArrayList<>());
            h = new int[N];
            inQ = new int[N];
            count = new int[N * 2];
            excess = new long[N];
            Q = new LinkedList<>();
        }

        int addEdge(int from, int to, int cap) {
            G.get(from).add(edges.size());
            edges.add(new Edge(from, to, cap, 0));
            G.get(to).add(edges.size());
            edges.add(new Edge(to, from, 0, 0));
            return G.get(from).get(G.get(from).size() - 1);
        }

        void enQueue(int u) {
            if (inQ[u] == 0 && excess[u] > 0) {
                Q.add(u);
                inQ[u] = 1;
            }
        }

        void Push(int edgeIdx) {
            Edge e = edges.get(edgeIdx);
            int toPush = (int) Math.min(e.cap - e.flow, excess[e.from]);
            if (toPush > 0 && h[e.from] > h[e.to]) {
                e.flow += toPush;
                excess[e.to] += toPush;
                excess[e.from] -= toPush;
                edges.get(edgeIdx ^ 1).flow -= toPush;
                enQueue(e.to);
            }
        }

        void Relabel(int u) {
            count[h[u]]--;
            h[u] = 2 * N - 2;
            for (int i : G.get(u)) {
                Edge e = edges.get(i);
                if (e.cap > e.flow) {
                    h[u] = Math.min(h[u], h[e.to]);
                }
            }
            count[++h[u]]++;
        }

        void gapRelabel(int height) {
            for (int u = 0; u < N; u++) {
                if (h[u] >= height && h[u] < N) {
                    count[h[u]]--;
                    h[u] = N;
                    count[h[u]]++;
                    enQueue(u);
                }
            }
        }

        void Discharge(int u) {
            for (int i : G.get(u)) {
                if (excess[u] <= 0) break;
                Push(i);
            }
            if (excess[u] > 0) {
                if (h[u] < N && count[h[u]] < 2) {
                    gapRelabel(h[u]);
                } else {
                    Relabel(u);
                }
            } else {
                if (!Q.isEmpty()) {
                    int front = Q.poll();
                    inQ[front] = 0;
                }
            }
        }

        long getFlow(int src, int snk) {
            h[src] = N;
            inQ[src] = 1;
            inQ[snk] = 1;
            count[0] = N - (count[N] = 1);
            for (int i : G.get(src)) {
                excess[src] += edges.get(i).cap;
                Push(i);
            }
            while (!Q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = Q.poll();
                inQ[u] = 0;
                Discharge(u);
            }
            return excess[snk];
        }
    }

    static final int N = 25;
    static final int oo = 10007;
    static int[][] dis = new int[N][N];
    static String[] s = new String[N];
    static String[] t = new String[N];
    static int n, k;
    static int[] dx = {1, 0, -1, 0};
    static int[] dy = {0, 1, 0, -1};

    static List<int[]> source = new ArrayList<>();
    static List<int[]> sink = new ArrayList<>();
    static int[][] sinkid = new int[N][N];

    static void bfs(int x, int y) {
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(dis[i], -1);
        }
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        dis[x][y] = 0;
        q.offer(new int[]{x, y});
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] p = q.poll();
            int xx = p[0], yy = p[1];
            for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++) {
                int nx = xx + dx[j];
                int ny = yy + dy[j];
                if (nx < 0 || nx >= n || ny < 0 || ny >= n) continue;
                if (dis[nx][ny] != -1) continue;
                if (t[nx].charAt(ny) == 'Y' || t[nx].charAt(ny) == 'Z') continue;
                dis[nx][ny] = dis[xx][yy] + 1;
                q.offer(new int[]{nx, ny});
            }
        }
    }

    static int[][][] dp = new int[65][12][12][12][12];

    static int pos(int tVal, int x0, int y0, int x, int y) {
        if (dis[x0][y0] < tVal) return 0;
        if (x0 == x && y0 == y) return 1;
        if (tVal >= k) return 0;
        if (dis[x0][y0] <= tVal) return 0;
        if (dp[tVal][x0][y0][x][y] != -1) return dp[tVal][x0][y0][x][y];
        for (int j = 0; j < 4; j++) {
            int xx = x0 + dx[j];
            int yy = y0 + dy[j];
            if (xx < 0 || xx >= n || yy < 0 || yy >= n) continue;
            if (s[xx].charAt(yy) == 'Y') continue;
            if (s[xx].charAt(yy) == 'Z') continue;
            if (pos(tVal + 1, xx, yy, x, y) == 1) {
                return dp[tVal][x0][y0][x][y] = 1;
            }
        }
        return dp[tVal][x0][y0][x][y] = 0;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        k = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            s[i] = br.readLine();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            t[i] = br.readLine();
        }

        int x = -1, y = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (t[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    x = i;
                    y = j;
                }
            }
        }

        bfs(x, y);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (dis[i][j] == -1) dis[i][j] = oo;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char c = s[i].charAt(j);
                if (c == 'Z' || c == 'Y' || c == '0') continue;
                source.add(new int[]{i, j});
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char c = t[i].charAt(j);
                if (c == 'Z' || c == 'Y' || c == '0') continue;
                sink.add(new int[]{i, j});
            }
        }

        PushRelabel g = new PushRelabel(source.size() + sink.size() + 2);
        for (int i = 0; i < source.size(); i++) {
            int[] posS = source.get(i);
            g.addEdge(0, i + 1, s[posS[0]].charAt(posS[1]) - '0');
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < sink.size(); i++) {
            int[] posT = sink.get(i);
            g.addEdge(source.size() + i + 1, source.size() + sink.size() + 1, t[posT[0]].charAt(posT[1]) - '0');
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < source.size(); i++) {
            int[] posS = source.get(i);
            for (int j = 0; j < sink.size(); j++) {
                int[] posT = sink.get(j);
                if (pos(0, posS[0], posS[1], posT[0], posT[1]) == 1) {
                    g.addEdge(i + 1, source.size() + j + 1, oo);
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(g.getFlow(0, source.size() + sink.size() + 1));
    }
}
